title: dryopteris persimilis
intro: Dryopteris persimilis, commonly known as autumn fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of autumn fern include anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and autoimmune diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris persimilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
